metadata.title: The CEO of Telefónica Knows He’s on the Front Lines of Europe’s Scramble for Autonomy<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The CEO of Telefónica Knows He’s on the Front Lines of Europe’s Scramble for Autonomy
“If Europe wants to have its own security policy…it cannot depend on savvy billionaires or on third parties.”
After years of flying under the markets’ radar, telecommunications companies are having their day in the sun.
